_about: Public-domain F. W. Grant (Frederick William Grant, 1834-1902, Brethren, Plainfield NJ) for the Word Hoard: six of the seven volumes of The Numerical Bible (his revised translation with notes; Loizeaux editions copyright 1901-1903; vol. 4, Ezekiel, was finished by others and published after 1930), Facts and Theories as to a Future State (catalogued 1879), Spiritual Law in the Natural World (1891) and The Revelation of Christ, raw Internet Archive OCR. Number-symbolism exegesis; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
